description: Moves everything in conversation_id (messages, calls, emails, tasks) into target_conversation_id and removes the empty one, as the thread menu's Merge does. It cannot be split back. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; the same pair merges once.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: merge_conversations
title: Merge two conversations
